**Why Amari Vitality Chose The Luxora Collective | Client Success Story with Natasha**

What makes a med spa owner choose a growth partner? And what actually happens after they say yes?

In this interview, I sit down with **Natasha, owner of Amari Vitality**, to have an honest conversation about why she decided to work with us at **The Luxora Collective**, what challenges her practice was facing, and the transformation she's already seeing inside her business.

We talk about:
• Why she knew she needed more than just another marketing agency
• The biggest bottlenecks holding her practice back
• What it was like working with our team
• How we've helped improve her marketing, patient journey, and internal systems
• The impact our coaching and implementation has had on her team
• Why building a scalable, profitable practice requires more than just generating leads

At The Luxora Collective, we don't just help med spas get more patients. We help owners build predictable, sustainable growth by optimizing every stage of the patient journey, from marketing and conversion to retention and long-term revenue.

If you're a med spa owner who feels like you're working harder than ever but your practice still isn't growing the way it should, this conversation is for you.
